text: A gigantic snail composed of grime and filth.  It has wings and it has a gaunt appearance.  Beware its deadly spittle!
translation: 一種由汙垢和穢物構成的巨大蝸牛。它長有翅膀，外表憔悴。當心其致命的唾沫！

text: A great feathered humanoid.  It has a pair of long antennae.  Its black feathers are fluffed-out.  This night creature was first created by the dwarven dark stalker Momuz Rawnesscastle of Shockcrafts after horrible experiments on multitudes in Cavernroads in the year 1887.
translation: 一種巨大的有羽毛人形生物。它有一對長長的觸角。它的黑色羽毛蓬鬆張開。這種夜行生物最初由矮人黑暗追蹤者——驚駭工藝的莫穆茲·羅內斯堡在1887年於洞窟之路對眾人進行恐怖實驗後創造。

text: A great one-eyed tick.  It has two long, spiral horns and it moves deliberately.  Its rose taupe exoskeleton is leathery.  Beware its fire!
translation: 一隻巨大的獨眼蜱蟲。它長有兩個長長的螺旋狀角，行動從容不迫。它的玫瑰灰褐色的外骨骼堅韌如皮革。當心它的火焰！

text: A large humanoid with lidless eyes. It has a short tail and its joints are backward. Its gray skin is waxy. Now you will know why you fear the night.
translation: 一種沒有眼瞼的大型人形生物。它有一條短尾，關節向後彎曲。它的灰色皮膚像蠟一樣。現在你將明白為何懼怕黑夜。

text: A large skink twisted into humanoid form. It is crazed for blood and flesh. Its eyes glow blue. Its charcoal scales are blocky and close-set. Now you will know why you fear the night.
translation: 一隻被扭曲成人形的大型石龍子。它嗜血嗜肉，瘋狂不已。它的眼睛發著藍光。它的炭黑色鱗片呈塊狀且緊密排列。現在你將明白為何懼怕黑夜。

text: A small skinless humanoid.  It has a curling trunk and it hurls vicious insults constantly.  Now you will know why you fear the night.
translation: 一種小型無皮人形生物。它長有捲曲的鼻子，並不斷髮出惡毒的辱罵。現在你將明白為何懼怕黑夜。

text: A towering slug composed of salt.  It has wings and it has a gaunt appearance.
translation: 一種由鹽構成的巨大蛞蝓。它長有翅膀，外表憔悴。

text: A useful workshop for pressing liquids from various sources. Some plants might need to be milled first before they can be used. Empty jugs are required to store the liquid products.
translation: 一個實用的工坊，用於從各種原料中壓榨液體。有些植物可能需要先研磨才能使用。需要空壺來儲存液體產品。

text: A very large feathered humanoid.  It has a pair of squat antennae and with singular purpose it seeks to destroy the living.  Its slate gray feathers are fluffed-out.  Now you will know why you fear the night.
translation: 一種非常大型的有羽毛人形生物。它有一對短粗的觸角，懷著唯一的目標——尋求毀滅生者。它的石板灰色羽毛蓬鬆張開。現在你將明白為何懼怕黑夜。

text: Cages, ropes, and animal traps are found here. Cages can be used in cage traps or to transport large animals. Metal cages and chains are also used by the justice system.

text: Capture and train small animals here. Requires animal traps.

text: Carve a track in a stone floor. Tracks are used by minecarts with routes set in the hauling menu.

text: Certain injuries such as overlapping fractures require advanced medical contraptions like the traction bench for treatment. A traction bench object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 某些傷害（如重疊式骨折）需要牽引臺等高階醫療裝置進行治療。牽引臺物品必須先製作才能放置。

text: Chairs are required for offices to function, and a chair next to a table is the preferred dining arrangement. A chair/throne object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 椅子是辦公室運作所必需的，而桌子旁的椅子是首選的用餐佈局。椅子/王座物品必須先製作才能放置。

text: Chests and coffers are used in personal bedrooms for storing non-clothing objects. They are also used in some zone-based locations like taverns, hospitals, and libraries for storing useful materials. A box object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 箱子和保險箱用於個人臥室存放非服飾物品。它們也用於一些基於區域的場所（如酒館、醫院和圖書館）存放有用材料。箱盒類物品必須先製作才能放置。

text: Citizens that cannot be buried properly can still be memorialized on slabs. Slabs are created and engraved at the stoneworker's shop.
translation: 無法被妥善安葬的居民仍可從石碑上紀念。石碑在石匠鋪製作和雕刻。

text: Codices and scrolls in your library can be stored in bookcases. A bookcase object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 你圖書館中的抄本和卷軸可以存放在書架中。書架物品必須先製作才能放置。

text: Make mechanisms here which are used to make levers, pressure plates, and gears. You can also use mechanisms to link levers and pressure plates to other machinery.

text: Make metal bars from ore here. Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys. All tasks require fuel.

text: Make metal bars from ore here. Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys. Magma below the smelter will power tasks. You are responsible for placing the smelter above the magma, but no other fuel is required.

text: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here. Powered version of the quern. Must be hooked to a windmill or water wheel to function.

text: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here. Tasks are completed very slowly compared to the powered millstone.

text: Please load a fort to see the fort-mode tools. Alternately, please switch to the "Autostart" tab to configure which tools should be run or enabled on embark.

text: Pressure plates, like levers, are used with machines, doors, floodgates, bridges, cages, and other structures to change their state. The trigger for pressure plates can be set by creature weight, fluid, or minecart passage.
translation: 壓力板與拉桿類似，用於與機器、門、閘門、橋梁、籠子及其他結構配合，以改變它們的狀態。壓力板的觸發器可以根據生物重量、流體或礦車通過來設定。

text: Prevents adamantine clothing from wearing out while being worn.
translation: 防止精金布衣物在穿戴期間磨損。

text: Process plants and work with livestock here. Milk and shear animals, make cheese, and spin thread.
translation: 在此加工植物和照料牲畜。擠奶、剪毛、製作乳酪以及將毛團紡成細線。

text: Process raw fish into edible food here. Raw fish will not be eaten.
translation: 在此將生魚加工成可食用的食物。未加工的生魚不會被食用。

text: Remove the stockpile being painted permanently. Also removes existing zones.
translation: 永久移除正在繪製的儲物處。同時移除現有功能區。

text: Set a high traffic area. Use this in wide central passages.
translation: 設定高流量交通區域。在寬闊的主要通道使用此設定。

text: Set a restricted traffic area. Citizens will look hard for better routes. They will still use the area if other routes do not exist or are too long.
translation: 設定限制通行區域。居民將盡力尋找更好的路線。如果其他路線不存在或過長，他們仍會使用該區域。

text: Start painting a new stockpile. Once the tiles are chosen, you'll be able to set the details.

text: Statues can be used to decorate your fortress and add value to your rooms. A statue object must be made at an appropriate workshop first.
translation: 雕像可用於裝飾你的要塞併為你的房間增添價值。雕像物品必須先在相應的工坊製作。

text: Stone-fall traps drop a stone on intruders. Must be loaded with boulders.
translation: 落石陷阱向入侵者投下岩石。必須裝載石塊。

text: Supports will stop cave-ins in the rare event you completely detach a piece of your fortress. Otherwise, they are ornamental.
translation: 支柱將在你完全分離堡壘的一部分時防止塌方（這種情況很罕見）。除此之外，它們是裝飾性的。

text: The dead are buried in coffins. Coffins must be placed in their own tomb zone in order to work. A coffin object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 死者被安葬在棺材中。棺材必須放置在其專屬的墳墓區域內才能生效。棺材物品必須先製作才能放置。

text: These are DFHack overlays that add information and functionality to native DF screens. You can toggle whether they are enabled here, or you can reposition them with gui/overlay.
translation: 這些是 DFHack 懸浮層工具，可為原版 DF 介面新增資訊與功能。你可在此處切換其啟用狀態，或通過 gui/overlay 命令調整它們的位置。

text: These are the customizable DFHack system settings.
translation: 以下為可自定義的 DFHack 系統設定。

text: These are the tools that can be enabled right now. Most tools can only be enabled when you have a fort loaded. Once enabled, tools will stay enabled when you save and reload your fort. If you want them to be auto-enabled for new forts, please see the "Autostart" tab.
translation: 以下為當前可啟用的工具。多數工具僅在載入要塞後才能啟用。工具一旦啟用，在儲存並重新載入要塞時將保持啟用狀態。若希望新要塞自動啟用這些工具，請前往"自動啟動"標籤頁設定。

text: These automatically fix dangerous or annoying vanilla bugs. You should generally have all of these enabled.
translation: 這些工具會自動修復原版中危險或煩人的漏洞。通常建議你啟用全部此類工具。

text: These change or extend gameplay. Read their help docs to see what they do and enable the ones that appeal to you.
translation: 這些工具可修改或擴充遊戲玩法。請閱讀說明文件了解功能，再啟用需要的工具。

text: These ornamental objects increase the value of rooms in which they are placed. An offering place object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 這些裝飾性物品會提升其所在房間的價值。供奉處物品必須先製作才能放置。

text: These run in the background and help you manage your fort. They are always safe to enable, and allow you to concentrate on other aspects of gameplay that you find more enjoyable.
translation: 此類工具在後臺執行，協助你管理要塞。啟用它們絕對安全，可讓你專注於自己更感興趣的其他遊戲玩法。

text: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms. A window object must be made at a glass furnace before it can be placed.
translation: 這種裝飾性建築可以提升房間的價值。窗戶物品必須在玻璃熔爐製作完成後才能放置。

text: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms. Three cut gem objects must be made at a jeweler's shop before it can be placed.
translation: 這種裝飾性建築可以提升房間的價值。需要三顆在珠寶匠鋪製作好的切割寶石物品才能放置。

text: To see more detailed help for this command launcher (including info on keyboard and mouse controls), type "gui/launcher".
translation: 若需檢視本命令啟動器的詳細幫助（包括鍵盤和滑鼠控制說明），請輸入"gui/launcher"。

text: Tools that are enabled on this page will be auto-run or auto-enabled for you when you start a new fort (or, for "global" tools, when you start the game). To see tools that are enabled right now, please click on the "Enabled" tab.
translation: 此頁啟用的工具會在新建要塞時自動執行或啟用；全域工具則會在啟動遊戲時啟用。請點選「已啟用」分頁查看目前啟用的工具。

text: Track stops are used in conjunction with the hauling menu. They can also be used to add friction to minecart tracks.
translation: 軌道停止器與運輸選單配合使用。它們也可用於增加礦車軌道的摩擦力。

text: Type a command or click on it in the autocomplete panel to see its help text here. Hit Enter or click on the "run" button to run the command as typed. You can also run a command without parameters by double clicking on it in the autocomplete list.
translation: 在自動補全面板中輸入命令或點選命令，即可在此處檢視其幫助文本。按回車鍵或點選 “run” 按鈕，可執行當前輸入的命令。你也可在自動補全列表中雙擊命令，直接執行無引數版本。

text: upon receiving justice through a criminal's conviction
translation: 通過罪犯的定罪獲得正義

text: Use dyes here to color thread and cloth. Requires a barrel and bucket for construction.
translation: 在此使用染料為線和布料染色。建造時需要圓桶和提桶。

text: Use floodgates to control the flow of fluids between spaces in your fortress. Must be attached to a lever or pressure plate to function. Requires a floodgate object to be built before it can be placed.
translation: 使用閘門來控制你堡壘內各空間之間的流體流動。必須連線到拉桿或壓力板才能工作。需要先建造好閘門物品才能放置。

text: Use tallow (rendered fat) or oil here with lye to make soap.
translation: 在此使用脂油（提煉的脂肪）或油液與鹼液製造肥皂。

text: Use the gear assembly to connect axles and machinery together. Gear assemblies can be disengaged temporarily by linking them to levers.
translation: 使用齒輪元件將驅動軸和機器連線在一起。齒輪元件可以通過連線到拉桿來暫時脫離。

text: Used to make lye, potash, and milk of lime. Construction requires blocks, barrel, and a bucket.
translation: 用於製造鹼液、草鹼和石灰乳。建造需要一個磚塊、一個圓桶和一隻提桶。

text: Various mechanical traps can be found here. The pressure plate is also found here, which has applications beyond traps.
translation: 各種機械陷阱可以在這裡找到。壓力板也在這裡，其應用不僅限於陷阱。

text: Weapon traps use a weapon or trap component to strike intruders. Can be used with ranged weapons and loaded with ammo. Can use multiple weapons at once.
translation: 武器陷阱使用武器或陷阱元件攻擊入侵者。可與遠端武器一起使用並裝載彈藥。可以同時使用多種武器。

translation: 你可以在牆邊建造斜坡以通往上一層。斜坡上方的空間也必須是空的。需要岩石、方塊或木材。

text: You can build reinforced walls aboveground, in caverns, or in spaces you have mined out in order to block the passage of creatures, objects, and fluids. Requires two boulder, block, or wood, and metal bars. Provides some resistance to invaders.
translation: 你可以在地上、洞穴中或已挖掘出的空間內建造加固牆壁，以阻擋生物、物體和流體的通過。需要兩塊岩石、方塊或木材，以及金屬錠。能為抵禦入侵者提供一定幫助。

text: You can build staircases to connect different elevations. Staircases must span at least two elevations. Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 你可以建造樓梯以連線不同高度。樓梯必須至少跨越兩個高度層。需要岩石、方塊或木材。

text: You can build walls aboveground, in caverns, or in spaces you have mined out in order to block the passage of creatures, objects, and fluids. Requires boulder, block, or wood.

text: You can filter the autocomplete list by clicking on the "Tags" button. Tap backtick (`) or hit ESC to close this dialog. This dialog also closes automatically if you run a command that shows a new GUI screen.
translation: 點選 “標籤” 按鈕可篩選自動補全列表。按反引號（`）或 ESC 鍵可關閉此對話方塊。若你執行的命令會開啟新的圖形介面，此對話方塊也會自動關閉。

text: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass. You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone. Glassmaking requires fuel.
translation: 你可以使用三種不同型別的玻璃製造各種物品。如果你有沙收集區，也可在此發起任務以用袋子收集沙子。玻璃製造需要燃料。

text: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass. You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone. Magma below the furnace will power tasks. You are responsible for placing the furnace above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 你可以使用三種不同型別的玻璃製造各種物品。如果你有沙收集區，也可在此發起任務以用袋子收集沙子。熔爐下方的岩漿將為任務提供動力。你需要負責將熔爐放置在岩漿上方，除此之外無需其他燃料。

text: You can place floors for functional reasons or to enhance the appearance of the fortress. Requires boulder, block,or wood.
translation: 你可以出於功能需要或為了美化堡壘而鋪設地板。需要岩石、方塊或木材。

text: You can play a sequence of fortresses and adventurers in the same world. Uncover locations and artifacts for the benefit of your future fortresses.
translation: 在同一個世界中，你可以先後經營多座要塞、扮演多個冒險者。你發現的地點和收集的寶物，都能為未來的要塞發展提供幫助。

text: Your citizens need a comfortable place to sleep. A bed object must be made at the carpenter's shop before it can be placed.
translation: 你的居民需要一個舒適的睡眠場所。床物品必須在木匠鋪製作完成後才能放置。

text: Your most valuable objects can be placed for display in rooms to increase their value and to entertain passing citizens. A pedestal or display case must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 你最有價值的物品可以放在房間中展示，以提升其價值並供路過的居民欣賞。基座或展示櫃必須先製作才能放置。
